### Code notes (Perf / Lighting / Zones)
- `Perf.luau`: `CanCollide=false` on trim/tiny (`minAxis < 0.5`) unless path is structural (`stair`/`tread`/`landing`/`floor`/…) or furniture. Stairs *should* stay collidable; thin slabs/thresholds can still lose query/collision.
- `Build.luau`: `Lighting.build` → `Geometry.folder(model, "Lighting")`; then `Perf.apply`; then `Tags.apply` (Zone + RACZone on room volumes, `CanQuery=true`).
- Last Play: **Zone tags = 0**, `WaitForChild("Lighting")` infinite yield — that rbxm predates or missed this wiring. Rebuild required.
